title: An issuer's history page draws none of its runs when the issuer has no readable report, although its subtitle counts them and its home card describes a finished run.
expected: CM-032: one row per run of an issuer, newest first, with date, pathway and status; D-31: an empty state says what is missing without contradicting the rest of the page. History.tsx:85-86 and its doc comment say only that an issuer with nothing to read gets the 'No report yet' state.
actual: With history.empty set, History returns NoReport and never calls RunFeed, so the entries are dropped. Corvane Packaging reads 'Report history: two runs since June 2026' above 'No report for this issuer is held in this library yet', with 0 of 2 rows drawn (a Running run and a Finished run). The same holds for Tessaly Foods (card: Finished, 6 of 6 modules, a full lead), Ardenne Cable (card: Failed) and Lumora Health (card: Capped); each opens a page saying no report is held.
suggested_change: Draw the entries (RunFeed) under the 'No report yet' state when history.entries is not empty, or drop the run count from the subtitle for such issuers.

title: On the shipped build every S2 page says only 'This data file holds no library pages': no designed empty state, no explanation a reader can use and no way forward.
expected: D-31 (Pass: Library home with no runs shows the empty state 'No runs yet' with 'Start a run'); CM-036 (a library, history or activity with no runs says so); CM-019 (no pipeline wording such as 'data file').
actual: web/dist/data.js holds issuers: [] and no library member, so readSlice returns 'absent' and LibraryPage draws a bare paragraph under the h1: 'Library: This data file holds no library pages'. The designed NoRuns empty state (icon, 'No runs yet', 'Start a run') is reached only when a library slice with zero cards exists (checked with a copy of the fixture whose cards list is empty). The rail is the only control on the page; history, Overview and Changes read the same sentence under a different h1.
suggested_change: Draw the NoRuns state (and a 'No such issuer' style state for the other three pages) when the slice is absent, in the reader's words rather than 'data file'.

title: Following a link on an S2 page opens the next page at the previous page's scroll offset, and keyboard focus is left on the document body.
expected: D-01 (the reader lands on the bottom line first); D-38 (focus goes to a logical place when the opener has gone). A page opened from a link starts at its top.
actual: The shell's <main> is the scroll container and is not reset on a hash change. Scrolled to the bottom of the Overview (scrollTop 2244) and opening the Capital structure module through its item, the module page opens at scrollTop 2244 with its h1 2,180 px above the viewport (the bottom line and heading are not in view); from the history, 'Open report' on the last entry opens that Overview at scrollTop 689, h1 625 px above the viewport. In both cases document.activeElement is BODY after the route change. The cause is in the shell (S1: web/src/shell/Shell.tsx, App.tsx); the symptom is on every S2 link.
suggested_change: On a route change reset main's scrollTop to 0 and move focus to the page's h1 (tabindex -1) or main.

title: At 390 px the Overview's Limitations header runs past its card: the 'See the N gaps in Evidence' link is clipped, the collapse button is 48 px outside the viewport and the page scrolls sideways.
expected: D-42 (at 320 to 400 CSS px content reflows to one column without two-direction scrolling); D-32 (a link's text is never cut); D-35 (every control reachable).
actual: Limitations.tsx:78 puts the heading, the gaps link and the collapse button in one non-wrapping flex row. At 390 px the link's right edge is 389.9 and the button's 437.9 against a 390 px viewport, and <main> scrolls sideways by 48 px (39 to 49 px on the other three Overviews with limitations). The visible link text reads 'See the 7 gaps in Evidenc'.
suggested_change: Let the header row wrap (flex-wrap) or stack the link under the heading below the small breakpoint.

screen: #/library/:issuer/:run/overview at 390 and 320 px, For and against (partial: a 70-character qualifier)
title: A point's qualifier longer than a short label leaves its tile and widens the page at narrow widths, pushing the point's sentence out of view.
expected: D-32 (a qualification is wrapped in full, never cut); D-42 (reflow without sideways scroll). Overview.tsx:30 sets max-w-full and whitespace-normal on the badge, so wrapping was intended.
actual: With the qualifier 'Unhedged portion estimated by management from the last hedging schedule' the badge's right edge is 503 px against a 358 px tile at 390 px (503 against 288 at 320 px) and the page scrolls sideways by 113 px (183 px); the sentence above it is cut at the tile edge. At 1440 px it wraps correctly. The Badge's inner span is size-max, so the max-w-full on the outer element does not reach it.
suggested_change: Constrain the inner span of the Badge in PointTile (for example a min-w-0 wrapper with break-words) so the qualifier wraps inside the tile.

title: The Overview's 'Dates to watch' entries carry no trace control, although every other paragraph, row and figure on the page has one.
expected: CM-009 and CT-047 (exactly one trace control per paragraph, row or figure); D-06 (a figure or paragraph with no way to its source is a wiring finding); CM-043 (the dates come from the modules that own them).
actual: Key findings 5 of 5, headline figures 5 of 6 (the n.a. tile has none, correctly), points 6 of 6 and limitations 4 of 4 carry one control each; the four dated entries (a date, a state, a title and a sentence each) carry none, because the DatedItem type in slice.ts has no trace field and Overview.tsx:86-88 passes the list straight to Timeline.
suggested_change: Add an optional trace key to DatedItem and draw one TraceControl per entry, or record in the ruling that dates are exempt.

title: Switching the Changes page from Cards to Table drops each change's kind, direction words, cause and effect; only the measure and the two values remain.
expected: CM-198 (the table lists item, prior, current, classification/effect and evidence; 'Table/content only'); CM-053 (cause, consequence and qualification kept together with the change); CM-025 (the table form carries the same published rows).
actual: ChangesTable passes head ['Change', earlier, current] and one Sources control per row. For the six changes of the 2026-09-30 run, kind, cause and effect are drawn on the cards for 6 of 6 and in the table for 0 of 6; the direction words ('Lower by 0.3x') for 0 of 5. A reader who chooses Table loses why each figure moved.
suggested_change: Add the change words and a cause-and-effect column to the table (it already scrolls sideways), or add them under each row.

title: The fixture the S2 pages are drawn from contradicts itself on the basis of net leverage (reported or adjusted), the period of the 4.9x comparison and the pathway of the run Changes compares with.
expected: D-15 and CM-318 (a figure reads the same everywhere, reported against adjusted EBITDA is labelled); CM-022 (every figure carries period and basis); CM-052 (Changes compares only with an earlier run of the same pathway). The pages draw the fixture exactly (475 checks, 0 mismatches), so the defect is in the sample data a reviewer reads.
actual: (1) Net leverage 4.6x is 'Reported' in the For-and-against qualifier, but 'adj.' on company-adjusted EBITDA in the Library list and 'EBITDA 486 company-adjusted' in its trace derivation. (2) The Overview point says 4.9x was 'a year earlier' and finding 01 says 'in the year'; the Changes card and heading put 4.9x at 30 Jun 2026, a quarter earlier. (3) The 2026-09-30 Full review run is compared with 30 Jun 2026, which the history lists as a Monitoring update (its run head says Full review). (4) Only one headline tile gives a period (revenue) and one a basis (EBITDA margin); net leverage ('Net debt to EBITDA'), interest cover and liquidity give neither.
suggested_change: Correct the fixture (qualifier 'Company-adjusted', 'since 30 June 2026', pathway of the earlier run, period and basis in each tile note).

title: The static Changes page draws a narrower vocabulary than CP-8 delivers: three change states, two no-comparison cases, no cause classes, limitations ledger, regression recheck or 'Not comparable' verdict.
expected: CM-051 (three no-comparison cases), CM-056 (cause: New period, New source, Method change, Correction, Presentation, Unresolved; status: Unchanged, Strengthened, Weakened, Reversed, New, Not run this time), CM-057 (limitations ledger), CM-059 and CM-199 (regressions and recheck), CM-061 ('not produced' with a reason class), CM-332 (verdict words start the Effect cell).
actual: slice.ts defines Changes as none | pending | compared and the Change state set has Changed, Unchanged and Not assessable; Change carries kind (free words such as Value, Conclusion, Assumption), direction, cause and effect only. The pending page reads 'Comparison not yet run', not 'not produced'. Issuer changes (net leverage) and analysis changes (rating-outlook conclusion, refinancing assumption) sit together in one card list. Whether the static app is meant to carry these is the owner's decision.
suggested_change: none (owner: extend the static Changes slice to the CP-8 vocabulary, or record that the static app shows the reduced set).

title: The static Overview has no place for key charts, the entered-ratings band, an 'Earlier format' or 'Earlier methods' label, selected watch items or the year-on-year difference and better/worse mark; the reader accepts the delivered yearChange and tone fields and silently draws nothing.
expected: CM-042 (key charts), CM-047 (company band ratings), CM-048 and CM-060 (Earlier format, Earlier methods), CM-152 and CM-194 (selected watch items), CM-045 and D-45/D-46 (year-on-year difference and mark on headline figures and Changes cards).
actual: MetricTile.tsx:21-28 and ChangeCard.tsx:22-26 draw yearChange and tone, but readMetric (read.ts:471-479) and readChange (read.ts:680-709) never read them, so a slice that carries them is accepted without error and shows no difference, prior period or mark (probe: a tile with yearChange and a card with tone 'better' draw neither). The Overview type has no chart, ratings or label fields. The connected report (C3, C4) draws these.
suggested_change: none (owner: add the fields to the static slice and reader, or say the static Overview is the reduced view; a field the reader does not know should be refused, not ignored).

title: The Library home lists issuers whose latest run is Running, Failed or Capped, although CM-033 and CT-043 say only completed runs with all modules answered are listed.
expected: CM-033 and CT-043 (Only completed runs with all modules answered are listed). The mock (docs/design/mocks/library.md, 'Run states in history' and open question 5) draws running, failed and capped cards.
actual: Five cards: Finished 2, Running 1 (Corvane Packaging, 5 of 13 modules), Failed 1 (Ardenne Cable) and Capped 1 (Lumora Health, 7 of 13 modules, 'Not established for this run'). The matrix and the mock disagree; the page follows the mock.
suggested_change: none (owner: say which governs, then change the matrix wording or the library).

screen: every S2 address with a trace control (full)
title: The trace control is drawn at rest on pointer devices; the design system and CM-009 say it shows on hover and focus and is always shown only on touch.
expected: CM-009 and docs/design/design-system.md:345 ('shown on hover and focus, and always shown on a touch device'); D-06.
actual: TraceControl.tsx:11-12 states 'Visible at rest at every width'; only its box border appears on hover, focus or Show sources. All 22 controls on the Halden Overview are drawn at rest at 28 by 28 px (probe prints each control's size and opacity). The build is easier to discover than the spec; the spec was not amended.
suggested_change: none (owner: amend the design system to match the build, or hide the icon at rest).

title: The document title is 'Credit OS' on every S2 address; the route titles in the route table are never applied.
expected: WCAG 2.4.2 (a page title that names the page); D-36/D-16 (headings and titles carry information).
actual: document.title is 'Credit OS' on the home, history, Overview and Changes pages (and after every navigation). The h1 changes; the tab and the browser history list do not tell the pages apart. The cause is in App.tsx and route-table.ts (S1).
suggested_change: Set document.title from the matched route title and, on library pages, the issuer name.

title: Pressing 'Clear filters' removes the button that has focus and leaves focus on the document body.
expected: D-38 (if the opener has gone, focus goes to a logical place); D-34.
actual: After Enter on 'Clear filters', document.activeElement is BODY; the next Tab happens to land on the first card only because the browser keeps its starting point. A screen reader announces nothing.
suggested_change: Move focus to the search field (or the results region) in the clear handler.

title: A run that is still loading draws a skeleton marked aria-busy with no name, no text and no live region, so a screen reader hears nothing.
expected: D-31 and D-43 (states are exposed to assistive technology; the loading issuer card on the home already has role=group and aria-label 'Loading issuer').
actual: RunSkeleton is <div aria-busy='true'> with only empty decorative blocks; there is no role, label, 'Loading this run' text or [role=status] on the page.
suggested_change: Give the skeleton role='group' and aria-label 'Loading this run' as the issuer card does.

title: Trace controls on one Overview share generic names: five are 'Show sources for this figure', six 'this point', five 'this finding', four 'this limitation'.
expected: D-37 and D-06 (the control's name names the passage; no two different actions share one generic name on a page).
actual: Nothing in the name tells a screen-reader user which figure or finding a control belongs to; the drawer's own name ('Sources for net leverage') is specific, so the slice already holds the words.
suggested_change: Append the item's label to the name (for example 'Show sources for net leverage') or add aria-describedby pointing at the item's heading.

title: The search field has no visible label, only a placeholder (its accessible name comes from aria-label).
expected: D-37 (form fields have visible labels, not placeholder only).
actual: FilterBar.tsx:72-80 draws an Input with placeholder 'Search issuers' and an icon; no <label> element is associated (labels.length 0). The three selects show 'Sector: All' style visible text, so the search field is the odd one.
suggested_change: Add a visible or sr-only label element, or accept the placeholder as the label under a recorded exception.

title: The Cards/List and Cards/Table groups are role=radiogroup but the arrow keys only move focus; the choice changes on Space.
expected: D-35 (arrow keys for radio roles); WAI-ARIA radio group pattern (arrow keys check the next radio).
actual: With focus on Cards, ArrowRight moves focus to List or Table and leaves aria-checked on Cards; Space then selects it. The group is one tab stop. The component is the kit's ButtonGroup (X1); the two S2 uses inherit it.
suggested_change: Give the group role=group (toggle buttons with aria-pressed) or select on arrow focus.

title: Text written for S2 pages is set at 12 px in six places, under the 13 px minimum.
expected: D-30 (nothing written here set below 13 px; the 11 and 12 px exceptions in .impeccable/config.json apply to one mockup file only).
actual: text-xs (12 px) on: the 'Ran 13 Nov 2026' line of each history entry (RunFeed.tsx:46), the change words and 'from' value of each change card (ChangeCard.tsx:22, :51), the Limitations count (Limitations.tsx:84), the Forecast tab hint 'No forecast for this run' (RunFrame.tsx:68) and 'adj.' in the list (IssuerList.tsx:66). Badge text from the kit (12 px) is a source component and is not counted.
suggested_change: Use the caption size (text-caption 13/18) for these pieces.

title: Search, filters and the Cards/List choice are lost when the reader opens an issuer and presses Back.
expected: CT-043 (the reader chooses an issuer and a run through search, filter, Cards or List); returning from an issuer should return to the same list.
actual: Layout() keeps filters, bands and layout in component state; after List + search 'o' + Sector 'Rigid packaging' (2 filters, 1 row), opening Corvane Packaging and pressing Back shows Cards, an empty search and 'No filter applied' with all five cards.
suggested_change: Keep the choices in a module-level store like Show sources, or in the hash query.

title: At 320 px the run header's actions ('Show sources', 'Report history', 'New run') run past the viewport and the page scrolls sideways by 47 to 119 px.
expected: D-42 (reflow at 320 CSS px without two-direction scrolling; WCAG 1.4.10).
actual: On all Overview and Changes pages tried 'New run' ends at 367 px against a 320 px viewport (history: 14 px over). 390 px is fine for the header.
suggested_change: Let PageHeader actions wrap below the small breakpoint (PageHeader is S1's file).

title: ChangeCard.tsx uses the ReactNode type on line 36 and imports it on the last line of the file (line 68).
expected: Imports at the top of the module; the file's neighbours (ModuleItems.tsx, MetricTile.tsx) import first.
actual: `import type { ReactNode } from "react";` is the last statement of the file. It compiles because imports are hoisted, but a reader of the props sees an undeclared type and an import-order lint rule would flag it.
suggested_change: Move the import to the top of the file.

title: A module item that stands for several modules ('9 modules unchanged') draws a chevron and does nothing when pressed, while the items that do open a module have no chevron.
expected: ModuleItems.tsx doc comment: an item with a module opens that module's page; one without is plain. D-27 (an affordance only on interactive things).
actual: The chevron is drawn exactly when item.module === null (ModuleItems.tsx:26-27). Pressing the item leaves the address unchanged and the row is not focusable; the linked rows show no chevron. Overview.test.tsx:429-446 asserts this arrangement on purpose, so the intent is the owner's to confirm.
suggested_change: none (owner: keep the chevron as a 'group' mark, or draw it on the linked rows).

title: Every 'Start a run' and 'New run' button on the S2 pages opens the run page headed 'TransDigm Group', whichever issuer the reader came from.
expected: CT-043 and the S2 buttons' labels: a new run for this library; the issuer's name on a start page should be the one the reader chooses (S6 owns the page).
actual: RUN_START is '#/run'; the bare group address renders the first run route's home, the fixture's draft for TransDigm Group, with focus on the rail's 'Run' link. On the four screen types tested the link works with the keyboard, Back and Forward.
suggested_change: none (S6 and S1: confirm that '#/run' should open a blank start page).

title: The Overview puts the headline figures and For and against between the bottom line and Key findings; D-11 fixes bottom line, key findings, then contrary evidence.
expected: D-11 (bottom line, key findings, contrary evidence and what would change the view, limitations); CM-037.
actual: Order on the page: Bottom line, headline figures, For and against, Key findings (with 'What would change the view' and Dates beside it), Modules, Limitations. This is the mock's order (P1, F1, P6, P2, P4, R4, R7, P5 in docs/design/mocks/library.md), so rubric and mock disagree.
suggested_change: none (owner: confirm the mock's order or the rubric's).

title: Static library parts import two components from the connected report (ToneMark and YearChange), so the static bundle depends on connected code.
expected: Shared pieces live in a shared folder; sections.md records the dependency (C3 files drawn in the static library).
actual: ChangeCard.tsx:6 imports '@/pages/connected/report/ToneMark' and MetricTile.tsx:2 imports '../../connected/report/YearChange'. Their data (tone, yearChange) cannot reach them through the static reader (see the finding on dropped fields).
suggested_change: Move ToneMark and YearChange to a shared folder when the sweep (stage 6) reaches them.

title: Four near-identical empty-state blocks (NoRuns, NoReport, Absent, OverviewPrompt) repeat the same EmptyState header, icon, title and footer markup.
expected: One empty-state helper (the sweep, stage 6, looks for duplicated blocks).
actual: Home.tsx:48-66, History.tsx:14-39, NotHeld.tsx:9-26 and Changes.tsx:65-91 differ only in icon, title, text and buttons.
suggested_change: Extract one StateMessage component taking icon, title, text and actions.

screen: #/library/home card and history entry naming a run the issuer does not hold (unusual input)
title: The reader accepts a card href, a history report and a Changes link that name a run the issuer does not hold, so a card opens 'No such run'.
expected: read.ts checks trace keys, module links and counts against the run (opensHeld, itemsHeld, pendingHeld); the same check for card.href and history.report would catch a dangling run.
actual: With home.cards[0].href set to '2099-12-31', the slice is accepted without error and the card opens #/library/halden-aerostructures/2099-12-31/overview, which says 'No such run'. The same holds for a history entry's report and changes.run.
suggested_change: In readIssuer refuse a history report or changes.run, and in readSlice a card href, that is not an id in the issuer's runs.

title: A single unbroken token of about 200 characters in an issuer name, a finding or a measure label widens <main> and scrolls the page sideways.
expected: D-32 (long text wraps in full; no horizontal scroll for prose).
actual: Run states.mjs with the default token: Home (card name, sector), Overview (bottom line lead, finding lead, module title, metric label, date title), Changes (measure, values) and History each overflow <main>; with spaces in the same text only the non-wrapping pieces overflow: a 70-character qualifier (S2-005), a 90-character pathway badge at 390 px and a very long 'What changed since' link label.
suggested_change: Add break-words (overflow-wrap: anywhere) to the passage and heading classes.

title: Control row CT-028 (the earlier run Changes compares with) lists S2, but S2 offers no such control and the Changes page names the earlier run only by its date.
expected: CT-028: the earlier run is chosen by CP-OS and approved on the run start review sheet (where: Run start); the row's limits are same issuer, pathway and case kind. A row listing S2 should say what S2 shows of that decision.
actual: The Changes heading reads 'What changed since 30 June 2026' and the table heads carry the two dates; nothing on the page names the earlier run's pathway or case kind, and no control exists (checked: no button, link or field on #/library/:issuer/:run/changes concerns the comparison). Harmony row CT-028 is marked 'not reachable here' for this reason; nothing is wrong beyond the matrix listing S2.
suggested_change: Remove S2 from CT-028's section column, or show the earlier run's pathway beside the 'What changed since' heading.

title: The page-level 'Show sources' switch in every run header has no row in either matrix.
expected: D-06 names the switch ('plus the page-level Show sources switch'); the control matrix lists decisions a user makes (CT-047 covers only the per-item trace control).
actual: SourcesSwitch is drawn in every run header; Space and mouse toggle it (data-sources on/off), the state is kept in memory across a run's pages and resets on reload. It works; no row says whether it is a user decision to record.
suggested_change: Add a control-matrix row for Show sources (decided by the user, session memory only).

title: The navigation buttons and links on the S2 pages ('Start a run', 'New run', 'Open latest report', 'Report history', 'Library') have no control-matrix row.
expected: The control matrix is the answer key for what the user can decide; CT-043 covers choosing an issuer and run, not leaving for the run start page or the history.
actual: Seven distinct navigation controls are drawn across the four screen types (home header and empty state, history header and empty state, run header). All resolve; Back and Forward return correctly. Only 'Start a run' and 'New run' lead to a decision area (S6); the rest are plain navigation. See S2-024 for where the run start link lands.
suggested_change: Add one control-matrix row for 'Start a run / New run' (decided by the user, opens run start) and treat the rest as navigation.

title: The run tab bar (Overview, Changes, Modules with count, Forecast disabled with the hint 'No forecast for this run', Evidence) has no row in either matrix.
expected: CM-031 and CT-041 name the five pages of a run; no row says how the tabs behave when a page has nothing to show.
actual: Forecast is plain text with aria-disabled and a 12 px hint when the run has no forecast; Modules is plain text while a run is loading (no first module); the other tabs are links with aria-current on the page shown. Behaviour is consistent and keyboard-operable (4 tab stops after the header).
suggested_change: Add a content row for the tab bar and its disabled Forecast state.

title: The List view's three range-band selects and its 'Hidden by <measure>' lists have no matrix row; CM-034 covers only the adjusted label, the sort and the count line.
expected: CM-034 and R-21 (adjusted figures are shown with 'adj.' but never screened or sorted with reported ones); a row for the band selects and for the rows a band hides would let a reviewer check them.
actual: Leverage, Net leverage and Interest coverage each offer All plus delivered bands; a chosen band hides rows without a reported figure and lists them under 'Hidden by Leverage: no figure recorded, or a figure on adjusted EBITDA' with links (checked: Halden, Tessaly and Lumora listed under Leverage). The wording follows the predecessor's heading per IssuerList.tsx.
suggested_change: Add a content row for the band selects and the hidden-row lists under CM-034.

title: The List view's figure tooltips (basis and period of each leverage or coverage figure) have no matrix row.
expected: CM-034 and CM-022 (every figure carries its period and basis); a figure's basis and period are carried here by a tooltip and an sr-only description rather than visible text.
actual: Each figure is a button with a tooltip ('Reported EBITDA, year to 30 Jun 2026') shown on hover and on keyboard focus (focus reached by ArrowRight in the grid), described to assistive technology through aria-describedby; the visible cell shows only the figure and 'adj.'. Not in any row.
suggested_change: Add a content row saying where a list figure's basis and period appear (tooltip only, or visible).
